assumptions.message: Named field 'yearBought' as integer for 'the year bought'.
Named field 'currentMileage' as integer with default 0 and min 0 for 'current mileage in km'.
Named field 'description' (string, maxLength 255) for 'what was done'.
Used string field 'shop' (maxLength 120) to store either the repair shop name or 'home' when serviced at home.
Set initial currentMileage to 0 km for seed bikes ('Blue Arrow' and 'Muddy') as initial mileage was not specified in the requirement.
Selected 'Bike' Lucide icon for the app.
Selected 'Wrench' Lucide icon for Service maintenance log navigation.
Selected 'table' listStyle for Bike as records consist of tabular vehicle specifications without images or long text.
Selected 'table' listStyle for Service log entries.
Visualized 'Cost per bike' aggregate as a bar chart grouped by bikeId.
